integrity: Exact rational symbolic verification of sign polynomial, elimination and Sturm counts; no empirical computation is used to establish the infinite parameter classification; independent validation has not been performed.

title: A sharp curvature-heterogeneity threshold for when reshuffling loses to independent SGD
